Description: Canonical Tier 1/Tier 2 Store-fallback map. Sealed package-family identities are the preferred local re-registration route. Each removal-list package also has exactly one fallback entry; StoreId is empty when no current Store identity has been verified. ExpectedPackageNames must exist after Store fallback. A replacement Store product may intentionally differ from the removed legacy package and is labelled as such.

Microsoft.BingNews.ReplacementNote: The current Storefront and WinGet show still resolve product 9WZDNCRFHVFW, but the release-gate install/postcheck fails with ERROR_PACKAGE_ALREADY_EXISTS (0x80073CFB) when the removed user's package remains staged/provisioned, which is the normal Tier 2 recovery state. Only sealed local package-family re-registration is claimed until the Store fallback passes that exact post-removal scenario.

Microsoft.MicrosoftSolitaireCollection.ReplacementNote: The current Storefront still exposes product 9WZDNCRFHWD2, but release-gate WinGet 1.29.280 msstore exact ID, name and locale queries return NO_APPLICATIONS_FOUND. Only sealed local package-family re-registration is claimed until WinGet exposes a verified fallback again.
